teaser: A personalised edition of Generation Z Developers, assembled by an agent for one person from a private brief, and paid for as it is read.
core_idea: Once the book is a graph, an agent can assemble an edition for one reader from a private brief (their role, altitude, examples, later language), sent to them and not published, metered as it is read from five pounds of credit and kept in their vault, with the correspondence notes behind it staying private.

Each thing we build becomes something the next idea stands on.
